name: Hugo Simberg
bio: Hugo Gerhard Simberg was a Finnish symbolist painter and graphic artist.

paintings.title: The Wounded Angel
paintings.story: The Wounded Angel is a painting by Finnish symbolist painter Hugo Simberg. It is one of the most recognizable of Simberg's works, and was voted Finland's "national painting" in a vote held by the Ateneum art museum in 2006. In a similar 2013 vote held by medal and coin vendor Suomen Moneta, it was voted second most important.
facts: In a letter to his sister Blenda, Simberg wrote on 10 October 1903: "I wanted to share the good news with you – I was not rejected this year, even though the jury was terribly strict.
The painting inspired the album cover for Spiritual Black Dimensions (1999) by Dimmu Borgir.
The painting partially inspired the music video for the Nightwish song "Amaranth" (2007).

paintings.title: The Garden of Death
paintings.story: The Garden of Death is a painting by Finnish symbolist painter Hugo Simberg. Like many of Simberg's paintings, it depicts a gloomy, otherworldly scene. The central figures are reminiscent of the classic black-clad Grim Reaper, but paradoxically are tending to gardens; traditionally symbols of birth or renewal.
facts: In his childhood, Simberg was heavily involved in rural life.
This exposure to rural life early, allowed him to be able to create art based on the simplest themes of life such as life and death.
